name: Backflip

Platform.Operating system: Android v1.5 (Cupcake), 2.1 (Eclair), can go up to 2.2.1 (Froyo), and 2.3.7 (Gingerbread) via CyanogenMod
Platform.CPU: 528 MHz Qualcomm MSM7201A processor (overclockable to 768 MHz via root and overclock kernel)

Memory.Storage: Flash memory: 256 MB, 199 free; microSD slot: supports up to 32 GB

Battery.Battery: Standard battery, Li-ion 1420 mAh, stand-by: up to 320 h, talk time: up to 6 h
